paragraphs: gWorks sells cloud software for local government, covering financials, operations, and citizen services on one platform. The pages describe two product families, financials and operations, that a customer can start with in part and expand later. Financials covers fund accounting, utility billing, payroll, and citizen payments. Operations covers public works software for cities, counties, and utility agencies of every size.

The platform's fund accounting is described as GASB-compliant, with multi-fund tracking, encumbrances, grants, and audit-ready reporting. The Website module gives residents one login to pay utility bills, submit requests, check permit status, and renew licenses online. Citizen Engagement sends outbound notifications to residents by email, text, or automated voice call, including utility alerts and billing reminders. FrontDesk Payments takes payments online, by phone, and at the counter, and posts them to the same account and the same ledger.
The customer testimonials on the homepage are attributed to cities, counties, and utility districts. gWorks describes the product as cloud software built for small local governments on one platform.
